limits: Instrumented Web Audio API scheduling/graph tests, not a rendered browser audio capture or a listening assessment. Device speakers, perceptual loudness, and audio-to-screen latency still require on-device listening.

results.name: Public interface stays unchanged; audio remains lazy and unsupported browsers stay playable
The first gesture cue survives async resume without duplicate resume calls
Blocked or stale unlock events never replay a backlog of old effects
Dense mixed events stay within sixteen voices and thirty-two oscillators
The final output curve is symmetric, finite, monotonic, and bounded below0.69
Bloom cues begin immediately with soft attacks and moderate harmonic frequencies
Planting unfolds in four bounded notes; repeated cues stay capped and mute cancels the pending phrase
Moon gates play a quiet two-note response, debounce rapid crossings, and obey mute and voice limits
Position changes restrained stereo pan, with mono fallback for older implementations
Mute fades existing and future notes, blocks new effects, and re-enables cleanly
Repeated wake calls reuse the context and closed contexts recover safely
